'''Jordan Thomas''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[December 2001 Littlehampton tournament]] on 16 December 2001 with [[Invasion / In Complete Control|Invasion]] and [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|light side Theed (We Have A Plan)]], according to Elliott Weights's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3239">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-07-littlehampton-16-12-01d3239/ littlehampton-16-12-01], DeckTech (Elliott "Dengar 69" Weights, 7 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-07-littlehampton-16-12-01d3239/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
